dataset: ERA5 reanalysis accessed via Open-Meteo Historical Weather API
dataKind: Gridded reanalysis estimates; not city monitoring-station observations.
spatialSelection: Nearest native ERA5 grid point; elevation adjustment disabled (elevation=nan).
calendar: Full UTC year. Fixed local standard-time offsets are available for aggregation; daylight saving time is not applied.
precision: Stored values rounded to 0.1 C, 0.1 percentage point or 0.1 input unit; app summaries and counts use these retained hourly values.

humidity.label: Relative humidity
humidity.method: Open-Meteo relative humidity at 2 m from ERA5.

utci.label: UTCI · no added radiant heat
utci.method: Bröde sixth-order polynomial through thermofeel. Mean radiant temperature equals air temperature: a no-added-radiant-heat scenario, not observed urban shade or full-sun UTCI. Humidity converted to vapour pressure with thermofeel Hardy saturation pressure.
utci.wind: ERA5 10 m wind; values below 0.5 m/s raised to 0.5 m/s and counted in diagnostics.
utci.domain: Air -50 to 50 C; 10 m wind no more than 17 m/s; vapour pressure no more than 50 hPa; RH 0 to 100%. Out-of-domain values are null.

wbgt.label: WBGT · exposed outdoors
wbgt.method: Physically based Liljegren energy-balance model through thermofeel.calculate_wbgt_liljegren. WBGT = 0.7 natural wet-bulb + 0.2 globe + 0.1 air temperature. Solar radiation uses Open-Meteo instantaneous-time estimates; cosine of solar zenith uses earthkit-meteo at the returned grid point and UTC timestamp.
wbgt.wind: KNMI/Liljegren stability-dependent 10 m to 2 m conversion; 10 m floor 0.62 m/s, internal 2 m floor 0.13 m/s.
wbgt.radiation: Direct-horizontal/global-horizontal fraction; package caps fraction at 0.9 and removes direct beam at zenith above 89.5 degrees. Default Liljegren clear-sky atmospheric emissivity, surface temperature equal to air temperature, surface albedo 0.45 and emissivity 0.999 retained. No measured street-scale radiative environment.
wbgt.propertyFitFilter: Conservative application filter, not a published whole-model validity range: omit hours when the converged mean of air and natural-wet-bulb temperature is outside 283 to 313 K, the documented fit range of the latent-heat property helper. Each WBGT scenario is filtered separately. Summary averages are conditional on retained hours; omitted hours are not zero or known below threshold.
wbgt.interpretation: Historical screening estimate, not a measured workplace WBGT, work/rest prescription or compliance determination. Interpretation depends on workload, clothing and acclimatization. WBGT is not a cold-stress measure.

wbgtShade.label: WBGT · no shortwave radiation
wbgtShade.method: Same Liljegren sensor energy-balance solvers and ambient wind profile, with all shortwave radiation at the sensors removed. No-solar-load WBGT = 0.7 natural wet-bulb + 0.3 globe temperature. Longwave model assumptions remain; this does not reconstruct actual shade at a site. The same 283 to 313 K property-fit application filter is applied using this scenario's natural-wet-bulb temperature.
